tickets.title: Prepare appreciated stock donation analysis
tickets.text: Compare donating cash vs. low-basis Paper Otter Robotics shares to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund at Silver Marmot Foundation, including expected reduction in concentration and records needed for the transfer. The Velvet Acorn Custody account holds about $390,000 of Paper Otter Robotics stock with an estimated $265,000 embedded long-term gain.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that appreciated stock donation analysis by March 20, 2024.

tickets.title: Review Paper Otter Robotics lots for charitable selection
tickets.text: Review the concentrated Paper Otter Robotics stock lots in Nora Velvetreed's taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody to identify lot-selection details relevant before she chooses assets for charitable funding. Several taxable lots have large unrealized gains.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots by March 27, 2024.

tickets.title: Address charitable giving timeline before filing closes
tickets.text: Address the charitable giving timeline for Nora and Sam Velvetreed so prior-year records and current-year items are correctly placed before Priya Dewspindle's filing package closes. The 2023 federal return was extended and Priya is coordinating the filing package.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable giving timeline before the filing package closes by March 25, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain Silver Marmot Foundation contribution receipt
tickets.text: Obtain or resolve the missing Silver Marmot Foundation contribution confirmation needed to substantiate the donor-advised fund gift for Nora Velvetreed. The file currently includes only a bank transfer note for the contribution to the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain or resolve the donor-advised fund contribution receipt by March 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund balance
tickets.text: Reconcile the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund portal balance against the downloaded activity summary, checking whether pending grants, investment movement, or timing of deposits explains the difference. The portal balance was about $48,200 during the meeting.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to reconcile the donor-advised fund balance by March 29, 2024.

tickets.title: Support Marzipan Meadow Rural Clinic grant review
tickets.text: Support the review of the pending Marzipan Meadow Rural Clinic grant recommendation in the Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund portal and determine whether Silver Marmot Foundation needs additional information to move it forward.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to support that pending grant recommendation review by March 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Update charitable plan for eldercare access
tickets.text: Address the charitable plan for Nora Velvetreed in light of her mother Hazel Velvetreed's move to assisted living, including a possible modest annual grant category for eldercare access organizations in Hazel's county. Nora's priorities remain rural health care, first-generation college access, and local arts programming.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable plan after that family caregiving change by April 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA-ready charitable documentation packet
tickets.text: Prepare a single CPA-ready packet for Priya Dewspindle separating Nora Velvetreed Charitable Fund contributions, donor-advised fund grants, and any direct charitable gifts so deductible and non-deductible records do not mix. Nora prefers donation records organized well enough for Priya to use without repeated clarification.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA-ready charitable documentation packet by April 12, 2024.
